title: Fix social media icon visibility in footer

requirements.summary: Fix WhatsApp icon SVG visibility in footer social media section with proper fill color and styling
acceptanceCriteria: The WhatsApp icon SVG path in the footer social media section renders visibly on the deployed site
The icon has proper fill color matching the design system
The icon is clickable and maintains hover states
All other social media icons (Facebook, X, YouTube) remain properly visible alongside the fixed WhatsApp icon

file_operations.description: Inspect and fix the WhatsApp icon SVG path element to ensure proper visibility. Add or correct the fill attribute on the SVG path element to use a visible color that matches the design system (likely currentColor or a specific color value). Ensure the SVG has proper viewBox, width, height, and that the path element has complete d attribute data. Verify that hover states and click functionality remain intact for all social media icons including Facebook, X, WhatsApp, and YouTube.
